scientific_verdict: The inconclusive conclusion is supported. Boosting leads on development date-mean macro F1, but logistic regression wins on both final dates and pooled final predictions. Reports distinguish date means from pooled nonlinear F1, disclose narrow coverage and class-prevalence shift, make no profitability claim, and do not claim an isolated imbalance benefit.
reexecution_verdict: The formatter-only reexecution is disclosed, preserves the original evidence and exactly preserves the frozen scientific decisions and metrics. It is reproduction, not another independent experiment or model-selection opportunity.
